Our Promise
to You.

Trusted Sourcing. Fresh Ingredients. Better Taste.

At The Spice Studio, quality is not just a promise; it is our commitment. We believe that every great dish begins with carefully selected ingredients, fresh produce, and the highest standards of hygiene and food safety. From selecting the finest ingredients to preparing every dish with care, we strive to deliver an exceptional dining experience. We don't compromise on quality because you deserve nothing but the best.

THE SPACE / 01
ABOUT THE SPICE STUDIO

A Mangalorean-Inspired
Rooftop Retreat.

Located within 100m from CMRIT Engineering College, The Spice Studio is a visual and culinary treat. The restaurant is spread across 2 levels with a seating capacity of 150 guests. We feature artistic and tasteful interiors, beautiful and sturdy furniture, well-maintained ample greenery, and a stunning 20ft water curtain that completely transforms the indoor ambiance and temperature.

Our rooftop offers unparalleled views of the layout and is incredibly well-ventilated, offering guests a beautiful backdrop—especially during Bangalore's famous flower bloom. Behind the scenes, we operate a fully functional, modern commercial kitchen of 600 sq. ft., backed by a 400 sq. ft. store, and maintain separate, spacious, and spotless washrooms for men and women.

BIG DAYS, BEAUTIFULLY DONE

The Ideal Space
for Your Next Event.

The Spice Studio is the ideal venue to host private and corporate events. Spread across two levels, our dedicated seating sections can be easily and seamlessly converted into private party spaces. Whether you are hosting a corporate team lunch, a birthday party, or an intimate gathering, our 150-seat capacity and stunning rooftop views provide the perfect setting.
